summary: Part 1 of 2 of the Revibe training video '8.0 Warranties - Issues (Seller & KAMs)' (00:00-03:29 of 06:37). It covers the four-step warranty claim process: who repairs (within 1 year with no misuse declared, the original seller; after 1 year or a misuse declaration, the Revibe Repair Partner); finding claims in the Admin app under Claim Management views (R, W, WR); the claim page (seller policy timer, Tracker, Claim Details, attachments); steps 1-2 handled by Revibe; step 3 pickup (AWB creation differs by country; collection failed routing); step 4 seller action (mark Valid or Invalid under QC, Repair finished, ship-back costs, delivery failed). All 40 frames were opened. Frame t00000 is black; frame t00001 is the title card 'The warranty process'. Speech-recognition errors were corrected from the screens (WABLE to AWB, Revive to Revibe, Weibo to AWB, 'way bill' to AWB, Edit, Delivery failed). Part 2 is not covered here.

terms.meaning: A customer request for repair under warranty, raised by the customer through My Account and handled in the Admin app under Claim Management. Warranty claims are either an issue with the device or a wrong device.
Referred to only as the other claim type handled in the same place as warranty claims; not defined in this part.
One task-specific list of claims. Each view is one task. Letter prefixes: R = returns, W = warranties, WR = both.
Banner at the top of a claim showing how many days the seller has left (for example 8 days left). Shows (paused) on some claims.
Modal showing every stage of a claim's journey from Claim Created to Delivered, with dates for completed stages.
Claim status when the device reaches the seller; the seller marks the claim Valid or Invalid.

Shipping waybill created for a pickup or ship-back. Created automatically by Revibe for AE and ZA; created manually by the seller for SA (Saudi Arabia). The screen caption calls it a waybill; the material does not define it further.
The customer does not hand over the device at pickup. Routes to a new AWB or to Cancelled.
The customer refuses the delivery of the device; the claim waits at this status until the customer chooses a new attempt or declines.
The repair supplier that handles claims after 1 year or where the customer declares misuse. The original seller does not see those claims. Slides also name it 'Revibe Care+' (page 3).
